charts.title: TOI-1716 b: orbits around TOI-1716
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1716's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1716 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 8.082354 d
